args.code: (() => { try { const save = localStorage.getItem("farm_game_save_v1"); const data = JSON.parse(save); const milestones = data.unlockedMilestones || []; const tasks = data.activeTasks || []; const features = data.unlockedFeatures || []; const npcFriends = data.npcFriendship || {}; const npcSummary = []; for (const k in npcFriends) { npcSummary.push(k + ":" + npcFriends[k]); } npcSummary.sort((a,b) => parseInt(b.split(":")[1]) - parseInt(a.split(":")[1])); const events = data.eventHistory || []; const eventTypes = {}; events.forEach(e => { const t = e.type || e.name || e.eventId || "unknown"; eventTypes[t] = (eventTypes[t] || 0) + 1; }); const daysPlayed = data.daysPlayed; const totalHarvest = data.totalHarvested; const totalSold = data.totalSold; const currentWeather = data.currentWeather; const seasonDays = data.seasonDays; return JSON.stringify({milestones: milestones, milestoneCount: milestones.length, tasks: tasks.slice(0,5), taskCount: tasks.length, features: features, featureCount: features.length, npcSummary: npcSummary, npcCount: npcSummary.length, eventTypes: eventTypes, eventCount: events.length, daysPlayed, totalHarvest, totalSold, currentWeather, seasonDays}); } catch(e) { return JSON.stringify({error: e.message}); } })()
